input: queries is a list of Q ASCII-English-letter strings, 0 <= Q <= 100; pattern and each query have length in [0,100] and contain only A-Z or a-z. Empty strings and empty queries are explicit extensions. Integer inputs are plain int values excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists and strings are ordinary str values, without subclasses or overloaded behavior. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not dynamically validated. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: A fresh Boolean list in query order. A query matches exactly when inserting zero or more lowercase English letters at arbitrary positions in pattern can produce it; pattern characters themselves cannot be changed or deleted, and extra uppercase characters are forbidden.
mutation_aliasing: The query container, query strings and pattern remain unchanged. Each helper invocation has an independent matched-prefix index; result Booleans do not alias mutable caller state. The Solution instance retains no state; separate calls share no mutable result state.
numeric: All indices are at most 100. Character classification and matching use explicit ASCII comparisons, not locale-sensitive Unicode case rules. Every count is exact; no numeric conversion is applied to letters.
complexity: O(total query characters+Q+1) time and O(1) auxiliary space per helper call, plus O(Q) fresh output. Pattern length/character access is constant-time for the declared ordinary strings; unmatched remaining pattern is detected by the final index comparison.

helpers.name: matches
helpers.contract: Greedily consume a matching next pattern character; otherwise permit only a lowercase ASCII query character. Accept if and only if every pattern character has been consumed at the end.
